content: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2025-latest is the stable SQL Server 2025 (17.x) Linux image; Testcontainers.MsSql 4.x on nuget. GitHub windows-2025 runner image lists Docker but not SQL LocalDB; Windows runners cannot run Linux containers, so Testcontainers SQL must run on ubuntu runners. Local machine: LocalDB 17.0.4025.3 (SQL 2025) and Docker Linux engine both present.
